hints.title: Click-Through Rate Ratio Metric
hints.text: The click-through rate is defined as clicks / (clicks + views) * 100. If clicks and views sum to zero, the rate equals 0.

hints.title: Conditional Sum with Null If Safe Division
hints.text: Use sum(action = "Clicked") / nullif(sum(action in ("Clicked", "Viewed")), 0) to avoid divide-by-zero errors.

hints.title: Ads Performance Blueprint
hints.text: select ad_id, round(ifnull(sum(action = "Clicked") / sum(action in ("Clicked", "Viewed")) * 100, 0), 2) as ctr from Ads group by ad_id order by ctr desc, ad_id asc.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT ad_id,
       ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(action = 'Clicked') / SUM(action IN ('Clicked', 'Viewed')) * 100, 0), 2) AS ctr
FROM Ads
GROUP BY ad_id
ORDER BY ctr DESC, ad_id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Group aggregation and sorting by CTR and ad_id runs in linear-logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simple division without null handling raises divide-by-zero errors when ads only have Ignored actions.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: IFNULL wrapper prevents runtime division exceptions in constant time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handling of zero clicks/views and compound sorting (ctr desc, ad_id asc).

solutions.approach: Conditional Sum Aggregation with Divide-by-Zero Guard

solutions.code:
SELECT ad_id,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN action = 'Clicked' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN action IN ('Clicked', 'Viewed') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0) * 100, 0), 2) AS ctr
FROM Ads
GROUP BY ad_id
ORDER BY ctr DESC, ad_id ASC;
solutions.approach: PostgreSQL Coalesce with Nullif Safe Division
